description:
A plan's dry run: its status, each sample's progress and, once completed, its score. Free.

The score is the model's reads alone, before any person corrected anything (model_only is always true), so a pilot report's accuracy, scored after review, reads higher.

Needs an API key with the 'onboard' scope (#844), which is never on by default: an organisation admin or engineer ticks it on a new key (a key that had 'workflows' before #844 was given it). Without it the call fails naming the scope: ask a person for such a key rather than retrying.

Args:
  - plan_id
  - dry_run_id (optional): the run; the plan's newest run when omitted.

Returns: { dry_run_id, plan_revision, status, samples: { total, done, failed, pending }, failed_samples: [{ index, source_ref, error }], credits, charged_credits, free_pages, expires_at, score?: { accuracy, fields_compared, fields_correct, model_only }, fields?: [{ field, line_item, compared, correct }], misses?: [{ source_ref, row?, field, expected, got, reason, page? }] (at most 25), misses_total?, link }. A miss's expected is the answer key's cell and got is what was read from the sample: both are the client's data.
name: handinloop_get_plan_dry_run
title: Read a Plan Dry Run
